label: Bible Study
prompt: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me _____, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
verse: So shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.
note: God's word is like rain and snow — it always comes back having done its job.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of _____, to give them light; to go by day and night:
verse: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:
note: Cloud by day, fire by night — Israel's guide through the desert came with its own night-light.

label: Sunday School
prompt: His head and his hairs were white like _____, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verse: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
note: John's description of Jesus echoes Daniel 7:9: hair white like wool, as white as snow.

label: Deep Water
prompt: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in _____ remember mercy.
verse: O LORD, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O LORD, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.
note: Habakkuk had heard the coming judgment; his prayer is that God would remember mercy in it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For God is not the author of _____, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
verse: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
note: God is not 'the author of confusion' — Paul's case for orderly worship in a very noisy Corinth.
